| PLAN-006 | 7. Confirmation cancels only the listed seats with no cancellation fee and returns each original allocation once under current mail connection controls. Open-ended direct freezes resume only after staff agree an end. Earlier resumption needs a new exact preview accepted by the member, never recreates canceled bookings and charges no second fee. The scheduler crosses start and end once, including after a restart. Freeze dates are studio-clock days. Expiry and the next invoice move by the frozen calendar days at the same local time. Added days grant no new period allowance. A type may cap freezes and frozen days per rolling 365 days. A fee-bearing or changed freeze needs the member's acceptance of the exact preview. The owner declines a request with a reason, and members withdraw their own. A scheduled freeze withdrawn before it starts reverses its fee and date moves once. Each guest whose seat is cancelled is notified, and a reversed guest price credits its payer. A freeze never replaces statutory disability or relocation cancellation (PLAN-007). Current dates are studio-midnight boundaries; an ambiguous shifted local time uses its earlier occurrence and a nonexistent local time is refused. Caps apply per member and freeze type across packs; capped freezes require an end. The frozen-day cap counts actual calendar-day overlap in every rolling 365-day window; older days age out as new frozen days accrue. Paid visit and guest allowances remain anchored to the original paid term, so the extension spends only remaining allowance. Withdrawal uses an exact effects preview, leaves previously canceled bookings canceled and cancels new seats beyond the restored term with original funding returned. BILL-005 carries the native recurring-invoice agreement. BILL-002/BILL-013/BILL-014 retain provider collection and autopay obligations; PLAN-001 retains catalog and checkout, PLAN-007 and PLAN-012 retain termination and final-bill requirements, STAFF-001 retains named staff grants and revocation, and MOVE-011 retains portable records and reconnection fences before those doors ship. | Confirmation cancels only the listed seats with no cancellation fee. | none | none |

The price applies at that exact renewal once, with the same plan entitlements, and the original acknowledgment remains verbatim. A changed due date or source after acceptance stops invoicing for owner review instead of silently reusing the amendment. Without acceptance, the original price continues. The notice links to the existing one-step stop; cancellation prevents later invoices, charges and collection. Finite-pack expiry notices create no renewal. Restore excludes installation-local disclosure dispatch authority, including at the same origin. This is studio-balance debt only, never card or bank collection. BILL-002, BILL-013 and BILL-014 inherit exact accepted price and cancellation fences before collection ships; STAFF-001 inherits the named delegated right. The native notice policy and riders were approved by ct on 24 Oct 2026; provider collection remains with BILL-002, BILL-013 and BILL-014, and STAFF-001 inherits delegated rights. Approved rider acceptance (ct 24 Oct 2026): only a native human owner schedules notices; only the affected member personally accepts the exact future price, and without acceptance the original price continues. Cancellation is immediately available from an absolute authenticated notice link, no payment authority is granted, and restored dispatch remains disconnected. The personally accepted agreement records a minimum elapsed-day price-notice period. Scheduling cannot shorten it, an actually late notice cannot support price acceptance, and a price applies only at its stated effective renewal after personal acceptance strictly before the stated accept-by instant; at expiry without acceptance the original price continues. Every affected customer receives a required email attempt regardless of booking-email preference or in-app notice state, with the exact old and proposed price, effective date, accept-by instant and cancellation link. A failed or uncertain send is retained and visible to the owner and member, never silently dropped or automatically resent. | Only the member personally accepts a future renewal price. | none | none |

| PLAN-010 | 8. Per-guest limits apply across hosts in rolling elapsed-day windows to pass-funded holds, including existing future holds; the strictest applicable limit wins. A charged seat adds exactly its confirmed guest price to the consenting payer's studio balance after an exact stale-checked preview; Strap claims no payment. Late-cancel, late-move and no-show fees on a guest seat are host debt under the booking's terms, never payer or guest debt, and every reversal credits the reversed charge's debtor. | SCHED-009 | 7. The participant uses their own door; an owner records verified youth/legal-guardian evidence and the guardian accepts through their own sign-in. Adult delegates additionally need the participant’s acceptance. This grants only absence/makeup facts, never a household, contact, payer, health profile or general child account. The owner uses the booking staff door until STAFF-001; both phoned-in actions retain one canonical actor/member/right/channel/before/after record. Cancellation returns an eligible makeup credit once with its original expiry, move/restore reuse the same credit and source link, and full-target move offers keep the original seat until a valid claim. Initial full-class makeups refuse without reserving a credit. PLAN-009, MEM-002, STAFF-001, SEC-003 and MOVE-009 inherit these authority, identity, retention and allocation fences before their new doors ship. A legal-guardian grant records, from owner-checked evidence, the date the participant turns 18 and ends then. A youth participant never needs a sign-in or acceptance and cannot revoke a legal-guardian grant; the guardian, or the owner with a recorded reason, revokes it. Revocation is checked at commit on every door, replay and snapshot; existing credits and bookings stay the participant's, and the revoked party receives no further notices. Absence and makeup notices also go to each accepted guardian. A grant confers no waiver-signing, household or payer authority; MEM-002's relationships replace this store when MEM-002 ships. A grant replayed with changed facts is refused. Comp, unpaid and guest seats, no-shows, late cancels and makeup bookings never earn a credit. When an early cancel would return the credit, the absence preview shows it. Before the original starts, staff may restore an absence whose credit is unused, voiding it once. A policy may cap credits per participant per rolling number of elapsed days. | The participant uses their own door. | none | none |

The failed-autopay alert is BILL-002/BILL-007's obligation and the flagged-staff-note alert MEM-001's (pattern 1). | ATT-002 | 7. Desk collection records an exact positive external receipt linked to the assessed fee and booking, with a globally unique receipt reference; no processor is contacted or payment authorization claimed. One receipt collects one fee once. A reversed fee cannot be collected, and an already-covered member balance refuses further collection. Unallocated historical receipts remain member-balance payments rather than invented fee-specific receipts. Pending assessments, collected fees with receipt references, and waived fees with reasons are separate on the owner/member packs doors and the member profile. Waiving an assessed fee requires a reason, appends one reversal and preserves attendance and spent-credit outcomes; waiving a collected fee leaves member credit without sending a refund. ATT-003 retains its separate attendance-correction and recorded external-refund behavior. Each staff collection/waiver retains one canonical actor/member/right/channel/before/after audit, and replay never repeats the effect. Portable exit and native archives retain the charge, linked receipt, reversal and audit relationships. BILL-004 carries recorded card-on-file consent and authorization, SALE-002 carries processor/POS desk collection and BILL-008 carries processor refunds before those capabilities ship; SCHED-002 and PLAN-001/002 inherit their fee policies before shipping. | Desk collection records an exact positive external receipt linked to the assessed fee. | none | none |

| SALE-001 | 7. Gift redemption is native desk fulfillment; connected readers and provider payment collection remain SALE-002. Cards are assigned to a named recipient and have no expiration or fees; no bearer authority or automatic payout exists. Funding is an original-tender receipt and a liability rather than earned retail revenue. Eligible dated fixed-amount promotions enforce total and per-member use limits, exact SKU eligibility and explicit stacking rules; returns never reset their uses. Partial redemption is once-only and noncash, the sale preserves its discount and original-value allocation, and a purchase return restores the same card. An explicit authorized funding refund is bounded by both available balance and original funding and returns to its original tender. Every adjustment needs a reason and immutable before and after amounts. STAFF-001 inherits the named sale and refund grants, scoped denial and immediate revocation guarantees for wider roles; future member self-service under APP-001, APP-002 and APP-003 inherits recipient-owned authority, the paired STAFF-006 door and the same value trail. No new member-role command is introduced. | Gift redemption is native desk fulfillment. | none | none |

Templates apply to every existing booking/class message, including offers and grouped closure mail. This confirmation/reminder opt-out preserves existing waitlist-offer email; broader offer preferences remain MSG-008. A courtesy early cancellation suppresses both channels only with the existing audited reason. Member rescheduling shares staff eligibility, credit, cancellation-effect and pending-waitlist fences, uses online capacity and cannot override capacity or waive fees. Matching request identities reuse effects; changed identities refuse. Reservations are unique per source kind, source identity and member; initial confirmation and later offer are distinct events. Provider acceptance never claims mailbox delivery; refused, uncertain, opted-out, unavailable and restored-paused states remain explicit. Native archives and portable exit retain templates, choices, provenance, notices and outcomes without dispatch authority; after restore, the existing member-mail origin fence pauses new email until explicit owner reconnection and never replays old mail. Done covers current class and finite-pack capabilities.
